query: /pave-init turn 'run our lint script and open a ticket when it fails' into a workflow skill
setup: A one-command goal with an obvious mechanical acceptance signal. The correct graph is small; the run must cost almost nothing beyond it.
expected_behavior: The root dispatch confirms atomic; the planning queue closes after its single root entry with no children framed and no extra ceremony

The graph carries no role, guard, branch, or state field without an approved requirement or a credible material failure behind it - the trim pass removes anything that changes no required routing, authority, evidence, recovery, or acceptance
No layout reference ships: a single-writer workflow with a handful of artifacts is a written reason for leaving it out, not a silent one

The lead hook pair ships only if the generated workflow crosses compaction or session boundaries; otherwise the applicable reason for leaving it out from references/lead-hooks.md is recorded in the enforcement table
The generated package contains no state schema for state that lives and dies inside one session - prose carries it, per SKILL.md's mapping rules
Total planning overhead stays proportional: one planning queue entry, one review gate, no empty scaffolding directories
